selection: All fixed v63 YCB TRAIN12800 and VAL3200 queries; no scores or private data. No adaptive sample selection.
coordinates: nearest pixel=floor(query+.5); native9 offsets=((i+.5)/9-.5)*preserved ROI side. Dense validity requires continuous native coordinate and nearest pixel both in bounds.
radius2: Clipped axis-aligned5x5 square around nearest pixel, no circular radius. Region visible/full support are independent any-pixel tests, not center labels.

states.EXTERNAL_CORROBORATED_SOURCE_MASKS: target full1,visible0 and another annotated instance visible1 at same pixel
states.EXTERNAL_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_MASKS: target full1,visible0 and no other annotated visible instance at same pixel
states.OUTSIDE_FULL_SUPPORT: target full0, including holes/background; never renamed external

confirmation_scope: Other-instance visible mask is corroborating evidence under source annotations. It does not independently certify human physical visibility; both visible masks may be derived from pose/depth.
strict_external_5x5: 25 in-frame pixels, all target full1, no target visible pixels. Strict corroborated additionally requires other-visible union at all25 pixels; strict ambiguous additionally requires no other-visible pixels in the25.
interior_external_distance: Separately report exact external points with full inside Euclidean distance>2px and target visible outside distance>2px; no claim this equals a full5x5 square.
holes: Full-mask background components enclosed under4-connectivity, not touching image border. This is a 2D enclosed-void proxy, not proof of a physical3D hole.
boundary: r1/r2 uncertainty if corresponding clipped square touches frame boundary or has both0/1 target-mask values.
depth: Observed uint16 depth with official per-frame depth_scale to mm, if available. Zero is missing. No rendered target depth or occluder depth ordering is inferred.
source_GT_uncertainty: official rendered/depth mask proxy, no human point visibility truth
pose/mesh/RGB misregistration can affect native boundary pixels
visible-mask overlap between different instances is flagged
unexplained external support is ambiguous, never silently relabeled positive
GTinfo visible pixel-count deltas reported; full px_count_all may include projected off-frame area
preservation: No v63 cache/model mutation, no GPU, no PnP, no training, no private image/score reads.
output_dense: NPZ arrays keyed by sample_id; bool labels outside dense_valid are0, depth outside valid isNaN. Compare old dense targets only where dense_valid1.
